clauses.text_en:
MyEasyBuy buys goods from Chinese Sellers on your behalf. Because the Seller — not MyEasyBuy — decides whether goods can be returned to them, and because returns from Canada to China are slow and expensive, the best time to return or exchange an item is while it is still in our China warehouse. Please review your inspection photos as soon as you are notified.

This policy does not limit any rights you have under the Ontario Consumer Protection Act, 2002 or other applicable law.

本政策不限制您依据安大略省《2002年消费者保护法》或其他适用法律享有的权利。

clauses.text_en: If we have not yet placed the order with the Seller, you may cancel in your account or by contacting us. We refund 100% of what you paid for that item, including the service fee.
clauses.text_zh: 若我们尚未向卖家下单，您可在账户内或联系我们取消，我们将全额退还该商品已付款项，包括服务费。

clauses.title_en: 3. Cancelling after purchase but before the Seller ships
clauses.title_zh: 3. 已下单、卖家未发货时取消
clauses.text_en: We will ask the Seller to cancel. If the Seller agrees and refunds us, we refund you the item price, domestic shipping and our service fee. If the Seller refuses or has already shipped, the item will be handled as a warehouse return (section 4).
clauses.text_zh: 我们会请求卖家取消。卖家同意并退款后，我们退还商品价、国内运费和服务费。若卖家拒绝或已发货，则按仓库退货（第4条）处理。

clauses.title_en: 4. Returns and exchanges while goods are in our warehouse
clauses.title_zh: 4. 商品在仓库期间的退换货
clauses.text_en:
4.1 Window. Request a return or exchange within 5 days after the item’s status changes to “In Warehouse” (you’ll get an email with inspection photos). Many Chinese Sellers only honour “no-reason” returns for a short period (typically 7 days from their delivery), so we cannot guarantee requests made after our window.

4.2 Conditions. The item must be unused, with original packaging, tags and accessories. If you asked us to remove packaging or tags, the Seller may refuse.

4.3 Items Sellers usually won’t take back: custom-made or personalized goods; underwear, swimwear, socks and intimate products; food, cosmetics or health products once opened; activated electronics; second-hand, auction, clearance or “final sale” items; goods marked non-returnable on the listing; goods from outside mainland China.

4.4 Costs.

– Change of mind (wrong size or colour you selected, no longer wanted, price dropped): you pay the Chinese domestic return shipping and a return/exchange handling fee of CAD 3 per request (your first return or exchange request each calendar month is free of this fee). The original domestic shipping and our service fee for that item are not refunded.

– Seller error (wrong item, wrong size/colour vs. your order, defect visible in inspection, not as described): the Seller should cover return shipping; we pursue this for you at no handling fee. If the Seller refuses, we will tell you your options.

– MyEasyBuy error (we ordered the wrong option, quantity or link): we fix it at our cost — reorder the correct item or refund in full, including service fee.

4.5 Exchanges follow the same rules. A replacement item is inspected again when it arrives.
clauses.text_zh:
4.1 时限。 请在商品状态变为”已入库”后 5 天内 申请（届时您会收到附验货照片的邮件）。多数中国卖家仅在其签收后较短期限内（通常7天）支持无理由退货，超过我们的时限无法保证成功。

4.2 条件。 商品须未使用，原包装、吊牌、配件齐全。若您要求去除包装或吊牌，卖家可能拒绝。

4.3 卖家通常不接受退货的商品： 定制或个性化商品；内衣、泳衣、袜子及贴身用品；已拆封的食品、化妆品、保健品；已激活的电子产品；二手、拍卖、清仓或”不退不换”商品；页面注明不可退的商品；中国大陆以外发货的商品。

4.4 费用。

– 个人原因（自己选错尺码/颜色、不想要、降价）：您承担国内退货运费及退换货手续费每次 CAD 3（每个自然月第一次退换申请免手续费），该商品原国内运费和服务费不退。

– 卖家原因（错发、尺码/颜色与订单不符、验货可见瑕疵、与描述不符）：退货运费应由卖家承担，我们代为处理且不收手续费；如卖家拒绝，我们会告知您可选方案。

– MyEasyBuy 原因（下错规格、数量或链接）：由我们承担费用纠正——重新购买正确商品或全额退款（含服务费）。

4.5 换货 规则相同，换回的商品到仓后重新验货。

clauses.title_en: 5. After your parcel arrives in Canada
clauses.text_en:
5.1 Check promptly. Inspect your parcel when it arrives. We strongly recommend recording an unboxing video from before the tape is cut.

5.2 Wrong, missing or damaged items. Report within 7 days of delivery to joshuazhou406@gmail.com with your order number, photos/video of the outer box, packing and items, and the shipping label. Our responsibility and compensation are set out in the Compensation & Insurance Policy.

5.3 Change-of-mind returns to China are generally not available after international shipping, because Sellers do not accept returns from abroad and the cost usually exceeds the item value. If you still want to return an item, we may help at your full cost (international return shipping, any Chinese import charges, and handling), only if the Seller agrees.

5.4 Defects that appear later (warranty). Chinese Seller warranties usually cannot be used from Canada. We will try to contact the Seller within 30 days of delivery, but cannot guarantee a remedy unless the defect was caused by us. This does not limit any right you have by law.
clauses.text_zh:
5.1 及时检查。 收到包裹请尽快检查，强烈建议从未拆封胶带开始录制完整开箱视频。

5.2 错发、少件或破损。 请在签收后 7 天内 发送邮件至 joshuazhou406@gmail.com，附订单号、外箱/内包装/商品的照片或视频及面单。我们的责任与赔偿见《赔偿与保险政策》。

5.3 无理由退货 原则上在国际运输后不再提供，因为卖家不接受海外退货，且费用通常高于商品价值。如您仍坚持退货，在卖家同意的前提下，我们可协助处理，全部费用（国际退运、中国进口费用、手续费）由您承担。

5.4 后期出现的质量问题（保修）。 中国卖家的保修通常无法在加拿大使用。我们会在签收后 30 天内尝试联系卖家，但除非问题由我们造成，无法保证解决方案。这不影响您的法定权利。

clauses.text_en:
6.1 When. For cancellations under sections 2 and 3, we refund within 15 days after the cancellation is confirmed. For warehouse returns, we refund within 5 business days after the Seller refunds us (the Seller usually takes 7–15 days after receiving the return).

6.2 How. Refunds go to your original payment method (e.g., PayPal) or, if you choose, to your MyEasyBuy account balance. Payment-processing and currency-conversion costs are refunded in full when the refund results from a cancellation before purchase, an out-of-stock item, a Seller cancellation, or a Seller or MyEasyBuy error; for change-of-mind returns, processing costs already charged by the payment provider are not refunded.

6.3 Currency. Refunds of RMB amounts are converted to CAD at the same rate used when you paid.

6.4 Shipping overpayments (when the actual shipping charge is lower than the estimate you prepaid) are refunded as described in our Terms of Service, section 4.2.
clauses.text_zh:
6.1 时间。 第2、3条的取消，在确认取消后 15 天内 退款；仓库退货在卖家退款给我们后 5 个工作日内退款（卖家通常在收到退货后7–15天退款）。

6.2 方式。 退回原支付方式（如 PayPal），或按您的选择存入 MyEasyBuy 账户余额。如退款原因是下单前取消、缺货、卖家取消或卖家/MyEasyBuy 过错，支付手续费和换汇费全额退还；个人原因退货时，支付机构已收取的手续费不予退还。

6.3 币种。 人民币金额按您付款时的同一汇率换算为加元。

6.4 多付运费（实际运费低于预付）按服务条款第4.2条退还。

clauses.text_en: If we did not give you the required information before you agreed to an online order, you may have a right to cancel within 7 days after receiving a copy of your agreement. If goods are not delivered within 30 days after the delivery date in your agreement (or the date we later agree), you may have a right to cancel before delivery. In those cases we will refund you within 15 days of your cancellation notice. If we fail to refund, you may be able to request a credit card chargeback.

clauses.title_en: 9. How to request a return or refund
clauses.text_en: Use the “Return/Refund” button on the order in your account, or email joshuazhou406@gmail.com with your order number, the item, and the reason. We reply within 2 business days.

We use contracts and other reasonable means to protect your information when it is transferred.

clauses.text_en:
3.1 Submitting an order. You submit the product link, options (size, colour, quantity) and any notes. You are responsible for checking the listing, the option you chose and the size chart. Before you pay, we will show you an itemized summary that includes the item price, Chinese domestic shipping, our service fee, any value-added services, the currency, and the total amount payable at that stage. You will have a chance to correct errors and to accept or decline.

3.2 Two-stage payment. You normally pay in two stages: (a) Purchase payment — item price + Chinese domestic shipping + service fee; and (b) Shipping payment — international shipping + any value-added services, paid when you submit a parcel for dispatch. Amounts are shown in Canadian dollars (CAD) unless stated otherwise.

3.3 Price changes by the Seller. If the Seller’s price or domestic shipping differs from what you paid, we will tell you. You may pay the difference or cancel for a refund of the amount paid for that item. We will not buy at a higher price without your approval.

3.4 Out-of-stock or refused orders. If the item is unavailable, the Seller cancels, or we decline the order (for example, a prohibited item), we refund the amounts paid for that item, including the service fee.

3.5 Our right to decline. We may refuse any order that we reasonably believe is illegal, prohibited for export from China or import into Canada, infringes intellectual property, is unsafe to ship, or is part of fraud. We do not knowingly buy counterfeit goods.
clauses.text_zh:
3.1 提交订单。 您提交商品链接、规格（尺码、颜色、数量）及备注，并负责核对商品页面、所选规格和尺码表。付款前我们会显示分项明细：商品价格、国内运费、服务费、增值服务费、币种及该阶段应付总额，您可更正错误并选择确认或取消。

3.2 两段式付款。 通常分两次付款：(a) 购买款——商品价 + 中国国内运费 + 服务费；(b) 运费款——提交包裹发货时支付国际运费及增值服务费。除另有说明外以加元（CAD）计价。

3.3 卖家改价。 如卖家价格或国内运费与您已付金额不同，我们会通知您，您可补差价或取消并获退该商品已付款项。未经您同意我们不会以更高价格下单。

3.4 缺货或订单被拒。 如商品缺货、卖家取消，或我们拒绝订单（如禁运品），我们将退还该商品的全部已付款项，包括服务费。

3.5 拒单权。 若我们合理认为订单违法、属于中国禁止出口或加拿大禁止进口的物品、侵犯知识产权、运输不安全或涉嫌欺诈，我们可拒绝。我们不会明知而购买假冒商品。

4.1 现行费用以网站”费用说明”页为准。本版本发布时的费用如下：

– 服务费： 商品价 + 中国国内运费的 6%，每单最低 CAD 5；

– 国际运费： 按计费重量（实重与体积重取大者；体积重 = 长×宽×高(cm) ÷ 5000（DHL、UPS、FedEx 等国际快递）或 ÷ 6000（其他线路）），按 0.5 kg 一档向上取整，按您所选线路价格计算；

– 仓储费： 见《仓储与验货政策》；

– 增值服务： 加拍照片、测量、去包装、加固、保价等，按公布价格收取。

4.2 运费预付与多退少补。 打包前的国际运费为预估。包裹打包称重后计算实际运费：实际运费较低的，差额在 5 个工作日内退回原支付方式（或按您的选择存入账户余额）；较高的，请您在发货前补缴；如上涨超过 10% 或超过 CAD 10，未经您确认我们不会扣款，您也可改选线路、移除商品或取消包裹。应您要求我们会提供实际重量和尺寸。

4.3 汇率。 人民币商品价按结算页显示的汇率换算成加元，汇率为加拿大银行（Bank of Canada）当日人民币/加元汇率加 3% 换汇费。人民币退款按您付款时的同一汇率换算，您不承担汇率波动。

4.4 销售税。 MyEasyBuy 目前未注册 GST/HST，不收取 GST/HST。注册后，将依法对服务费、仓储费和增值服务费加收 GST/HST，并在发票上单独列示。商品的进口关税和税费另计（第7条）。

4.5 费用调整。 我们可通过更新费用页面调整未来订单的费用，已付款的订单或包裹不受影响。

clauses.text_en:

clauses.text_en:
• Chargeable weight = the greater of actual weight and volumetric weight (L × W × H in cm ÷ 5000 for express couriers, ÷ 6000 for all other lines), rounded up to the next 0.5 kg tier.

• Some lines add a first-weight charge, fuel surcharge, remote-area fee or sensitive-goods surcharge; these are shown in the estimate.

• Prepay and adjust: you pay the estimate when submitting a parcel. After packing we weigh and measure it. If the final charge is lower we refund the difference; if higher we ask you to pay the difference before dispatch (see Terms of Service §4.2). • 部分线路另收首重费、燃油附加费、偏远地区费或敏感货附加费，均在估价中显示。

• 预付后多退少补： 提交包裹时按预估付款，打包后称重量尺；实际较低则退差额，较高则发货前补缴（见服务条款第4.2条）。如发货前线路停用或承运商调价，我们会先征得您同意再更换。

clauses.title_zh: 3. 清关、关税与税费（加拿大）
clauses.text_en:
• You are the importer. Your parcel is addressed to you, and you are responsible for any duties and taxes assessed by the CBSA, including GST/HST and, where applicable, PST/QST, plus any handling or brokerage fee charged by Canada Post or the courier. These are usually collected on delivery or by invoice from the carrier. The only exception is a line expressly marked “duties included”.

• Goods from China generally do not qualify for the higher CUSMA courier thresholds; low-value shipments may still be taxable. Check the CBSA website for current thresholds.

• Accurate declarations only. We declare the actual price paid and a truthful description. We will not under-value, mislabel or split shipments to avoid duties. Under-declaration can lead to penalties, seizure, or loss of compensation.

• If customs requests information (for example an invoice or product details), please respond promptly; we will provide the purchase records we hold.

• Goods seized, detained or refused by customs or other authorities because of their nature, or because you did not respond or pay, are not eligible for compensation (see Compensation & Insurance Policy).
clauses.text_zh:
• 您是进口人。 包裹寄给您本人，CBSA 评定的关税和税费（GST/HST，及适用的 PST/QST）以及 Canada Post 或快递收取的手续费/报关费由您承担，通常在派送时代收或由承运商开单。唯一例外是明确标注”包税”的线路。

• 来自中国的货物一般不适用 CUSMA 的较高快递免税额，低价值包裹也可能需缴税。请以 CBSA 网站公布的最新门槛为准。

• 只做如实申报。 我们按实际购买价和真实品名申报，不会低报、错报或拆单避税。低报可能导致罚款、扣押或丧失赔偿资格。

• 海关要求补充资料（如发票、商品信息）时请及时回复，我们会提供所持有的购买记录。

• 因货物性质，或因您未回复/未缴税，被海关或其他机关扣押、扣留或退回的，不予赔偿（见《赔偿与保险政策》）。

clauses.title_en: 4. Prohibited items — we will not buy or ship
clauses.title_zh: 4. 禁运物品——我们不代购也不寄运
clauses.text_zh:
• 假冒、仿品或侵犯商标/版权的商品；

• 武器及仿制品：枪支及零件、弹药、加拿大法律规定的禁用武器（如弹簧刀/自动刀、蝴蝶刀、指虎、双节棍、飞镖星、伸缩棍、针对人使用的胡椒/催泪喷雾、电击枪），以及逼真仿真枪；

• 爆炸物、烟花、易燃气体和液体、含燃料打火机、火柴、压缩气瓶；

• 有毒、腐蚀性、放射性或传染性物质；

• 毒品及吸毒用具；大麻及其制品；处方药、未经批准的药品、管制物质；

• 现金、纸币、流通硬币、支票、有价证券、礼品卡/支付卡、护照及身份证件；

• 活体动物、动物或人体遗骸；濒危物种制品（CITES）、象牙；

• 淫秽物品或在加拿大违法的物品（如仇恨宣传品、儿童性虐待材料）；

• 依《加拿大消费品安全法》被禁止或召回的产品（如婴儿学步车、部分小型强磁套装、含铅等禁用物质的产品）；

• 中国法律禁止出口或承运商禁止承运的物品。

clauses.title_en: 5. Restricted / sensitive items — may require a special line, extra fee, or may be refused
clauses.title_zh: 5. 限运/敏感物品——可能需走特殊线路、加收费用或被拒
clauses.text_zh:
• 锂电池及含电池设备（手机、充电宝、电子烟、电动玩具）；充电宝和散装电池常被空运线路拒收；

• 液体、凝胶、膏状、乳霜、香水、指甲油、喷雾；

• 粉末（含化妆品和保健品）；

• 磁铁及磁性物品；

• 食品、茶叶、种子、植物、土壤、木制品、肉类、乳制品等动植物源产品（适用 CFIA 规定）；

• 化妆品、天然保健品、医疗器械（适用加拿大卫生部规定）；

• 无线发射设备（须符合 ISED 要求）、无人机；

• 非禁用刀具（如厨房刀、工具刀）、工具、可能被视为武器的运动器材——仅限接受此类物品的线路；

• 烟草和酒类（不接受）；

• 易碎品：玻璃、陶瓷、屏幕——强烈建议加固；

• 超大超重物品（超出线路限制）。

发现限运品时，我们会联系您选择方案（特殊线路、拆除电池或移除商品、退回卖家、销毁并由您承担费用）。违反上述规则寄运的物品不在赔偿范围内。

clauses.title_en: 6. Address, delivery and returns to sender
clauses.text_en:
• Please give a complete Canadian address, recipient name matching ID (for collection), and a phone number.

• If a parcel is returned to China because of an incorrect address, failure to collect, refusal, or unpaid duties, the return cost (if any) and re-shipping cost are your responsibility. Parcels returned because of our error are re-shipped at our cost.

• Returned parcels can take 1 to 3 months to come back to China.
clauses.text_zh:
• 请提供完整的加拿大地址、与证件一致的收件人姓名（便于自取）及电话。

• 因地址错误、未领取、拒收或未缴税导致退回中国的，退回费用（如有）及重新寄送费用由您承担；因我们过错退回的，由我们承担重寄费用。

• 退件返回中国可能需要 1 至 3 个月。

clauses.text_en: Delays caused by customs, carriers, weather, peak seasons, holidays (e.g. Chinese New Year) or government actions are outside our control. We will help trace the parcel. Delay compensation is only available where the line or purchased insurance specifically provides it.
clauses.text_zh: 海关、承运商、天气、旺季、节假日（如春节）或政府行为造成的延误不在我们控制范围内，我们会协助查询。只有线路或所购保障明确规定时才有延误赔偿。

clauses.text_en: When a Seller’s package reaches our China warehouse, we log it, match it to your order, and set the status to “In Warehouse”. This date starts both the return window (see Return & Refund Policy) and the storage period. We aim to log and photograph items within 2 business days of arrival.

clauses.text_en:
For each item we check, from the outside and without using it:

• that the product, style, colour, size/spec and quantity match your order;

• visible damage, stains, missing parts, or obvious defects;

• whether the item appears to be prohibited or restricted for shipping (batteries, liquids, powders, magnets, etc.).

We upload 3 free photos per item (plus 1 photo of the Seller’s package on arrival) to your account. If a photo is unclear, we will retake it free of charge.

What the standard inspection does not cover: authenticity or brand verification; functional or power-on testing; internal parts of sealed products; exact measurements (unless ordered); minor colour difference caused by lighting or screens; fit, comfort or performance in use. Sealed items (e.g. electronics in sealed boxes, cosmetics) are checked from the outside only, unless you ask us to open them.

1688 / wholesale orders: we count cartons and units and spot-check 5% of units (minimum 5, maximum 20); a full unit-by-unit inspection is available at CAD 0.20 per unit.

对每件商品，我们在不使用商品的前提下从外观检查：

– 商品、款式、颜色、尺码/规格、数量是否与订单一致；

– 是否有明显破损、污渍、缺件或明显瑕疵；

– 是否疑似禁运或限运（电池、液体、粉末、磁性物品等）。

每件商品上传 3 张免费照片（另加 1 张卖家包裹到仓照片） 至您的账户，照片不清晰可免费重拍。

标准验货不包括： 真伪或品牌鉴定；功能或通电测试；密封商品的内部；精确测量（除非另购）；灯光或屏幕造成的轻微色差；穿着体验或使用性能。密封商品（如密封包装的电子产品、化妆品）仅检查外观，除非您要求拆封。

clauses.text_en: This policy explains what we pay if something goes wrong while goods are in our care or in transit. It does not limit rights you have under applicable consumer protection law.
clauses.text_zh: 本政策说明商品在我们保管期间或运输途中出现问题时的赔偿方式，不限制您依适用消费者保护法享有的权利。

clauses.title_en: 1. Our errors and loss/damage in our warehouse
clauses.title_zh: 1. 我方差错及仓库内丢失/损坏
clauses.text_en:
If, while goods are in our care (from “In Warehouse” until handover to the carrier), they are lost, damaged by us, or we made a mistake (wrong item, wrong option, wrong quantity, missed item when packing):

• we will, at your choice where possible, re-purchase the correct item at our cost or refund in full the item price, Chinese domestic shipping, our service fee, and any value-added fees for that item;

• if the mistake is only discovered in Canada, we also refund the international shipping attributable to the affected item (by weight share), or re-ship the missing item at our cost.

• There is no separate cap: compensation equals what you paid for the affected item, as described above.
clauses.text_zh:
商品在我们保管期间（自”已入库”至交付承运商）丢失、被我们损坏，或我们出错（错购、规格错、数量错、打包漏件）时：

– 我们将尽可能按您的选择 自费重新购买正确商品，或 全额退还 该商品的商品价、国内运费、服务费及相关增值服务费；

– 如问题在加拿大才发现，另按重量比例退还该商品分摊的国际运费，或由我们承担费用补寄。

– 不另设上限：按上述方式赔偿您为该商品支付的全部款项。

clauses.text_en:
International shipping is performed by third-party carriers. If a parcel is confirmed lost or damaged in transit and you did not buy parcel protection:

• Confirmed total loss: we refund the international shipping you paid and compensate the goods’ value up to three times the international shipping paid for the parcel or CAD 100, whichever is lower.

• Damage or partial loss: proportionate amount on the same basis.

• If the carrier compensates us more than this, we pass the full carrier compensation to you.
clauses.text_zh:
国际运输由第三方承运商完成。包裹经确认在途丢失或损坏且您未购买保障的：

– 确认全部丢失： 退还已付国际运费，并按货值赔偿，上限为 该包裹已付国际运费的 3 倍或 CAD 100，取较低者。

– 部分损坏或部分丢失： 按同一标准按比例计算。

– 如承运商给我们的赔款高于上述金额，我们将全额转交给您。

clauses.title_en: 2.2 With MyEasyBuy Parcel Protection (optional, purchased before dispatch)

clauses.text_en:
Parcel Protection is a service guarantee provided directly by MyEasyBuy. It is not an insurance product and is not underwritten by an insurer.

• Price: 3% of the declared value, minimum CAD 3 per parcel.

• Maximum covered value: CAD 1,000 per parcel. Parcels worth more should be split or shipped by a courier line with its own declared-value coverage.

• Confirmed total loss: we refund the declared value (or actual purchase value if lower) plus international shipping paid.

• Damage or partial loss: proportionate value of the damaged/missing items, plus the proportion of shipping.

• Customs seizure (only where the goods were lawful, accurately declared and you co-operated with customs): covered on the same basis as total loss.

• Delay: not compensated as such; a parcel not delivered within 60 days after dispatch is treated as lost.

• The premium is refundable only if the parcel is cancelled before dispatch.
clauses.text_zh:
包裹保障是 MyEasyBuy 直接提供的服务保障，不是保险产品，也不由保险公司承保。

– 费用： 申报价值的 3%，每包裹最低 CAD 3。

– 最高保障金额： 每包裹 CAD 1,000。价值更高的货物请拆分包裹，或选择自带申报价值保障的快递线路。

– 确认全部丢失： 赔付申报价值（实际购买价较低时按实际价）并退还已付国际运费。

– 部分损坏或丢失： 按受损/缺失商品价值比例赔付，并按比例退还运费。

– 海关扣押（仅限货物合法、如实申报且您配合海关的情况）：按全部丢失标准赔付。

– 延误： 延误本身不赔；发货后 60 天仍未送达的包裹按丢失处理。

– 保障费仅在包裹发货前取消时可退。

Cosmetic damage to retail packaging (e.g. crushed shoe box) that does not affect the product is not compensated.
